gui.autoangler.title: AutoAngler - Auto Fishing for Starcatcher
gui.autoangler.result.no_rod: No Starcatcher fishing rod found in your inventory
gui.autoangler.spot_filter.title: Spot Filter
gui.autoangler.spot_filter.hint2: TNT spots drain progress and stay disabled
gui.autoangler.treasure_mode.tooltip: When on: while a treasure bar is active, non-gold spots are hit below half progress to keep the fish alive, and only gold spots above it; normal hitting resumes once the treasure bar is full
gui.autoangler.spot.basic.tooltip: Covers normal, thin, wither, creeper, leaf and crab-style positive spots
gui.autoangler.spot.tnt.tooltip: Dangerous spot: hitting it drains progress with no reward. Permanently disabled and never auto-hit
log.autoangler.rod_unequipped: Rod is not in main hand, re-equipping
log.autoangler.equip.swap: Swapping rod from inventory slot %d to main hand
log.autoangler.equip.offhand: Swapping rod from offhand to main hand
log.autoangler.cast_interrupt: Existing bobber found (state %d), reeling in to recast
log.autoangler.cast_success: Cast, waiting for the bobber to land and a bite
log.autoangler.bite_handled: A biting bobber was found, reeling in directly
log.autoangler.reel_pending: Bobber is fighting, waiting for the minigame screen
log.autoangler.bobber_lost: Bobber wait timeout (cast failed or bite missed), recasting
log.autoangler.reel_retry: Reel did not work, bobber is still biting, retrying
log.autoangler.minigame_skipped: Minigame did not open (maybe skipped), recasting
log.autoangler.recast_forced: Idle for 3 samples, forcing a recast
log.autoangler.treasure.start: Treasure detected, entering Treasure Mode: holding progress and filling the treasure bar with gold spots
log.autoangler.treasure.done: Treasure bar filled, back to normal fishing
log.autoangler.minigame.layers: Layered spots detected: dimmed spots sit on other layers; the pointer layer will be switched before hitting them
